help.title: Quick start
help.intro: {{app}} keeps your agent skills in one library and installs them wherever you need them.

library.title: One library
library.body: Every skill lives once in the library. Tag skills, read their documents and see which agents have them.

install.title: Get skills
install.body: Install from the marketplace, a Git repository, a folder or an archive, or scan this computer and import what your agents already have.

agents.title: Install for agents
agents.body: Click an agent badge on a skill to install or remove it for that agent. An agent's page shows everything in its skills folder, managed or not.

presets.title: Presets
presets.body: Group skills into presets and add a whole set to an agent or a project with one click. Editing a preset never changes files by itself.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Link a project folder to manage the skills inside it, compare them with the library and move changes either way.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: Back the library up to a Git repository to restore it later or keep several computers in step.

oneAgent.title: One agent
steps: Install skills into the library from Install.
Open the agent's page and add skills with Add from library, or click its badge on a skill card.
Keep only what you use: remove a skill from the agent and it stays in the library for later.

projects.title: Several projects
steps: Group the skills each kind of project needs into a preset.
Link each project folder, then apply the preset to add those skills to the project's agents.
Edited a skill inside a project? Use Update library, then Pull from library in the other projects.

devices.title: Several computers
steps: On the first computer, open Backup and connect a private Git repository.
On the next computer, choose to restore from a backup when {{app}} first starts, or connect the same repository from Backup.
Changes sync in the background. If both computers edit the same skill, pick which version to keep under Needs attention.

shortcuts.sectionLibrary: Show the library in the sidebar

safety.title: How your files are kept safe

agentFolders.title: Agent folders
agentFolders.body: {{app}} never overwrites or deletes anything in an agent's folder that it did not put there; a clash is reported with the exact path instead. A folder several agents share is cleaned up only when none of them still uses it.

editor.title: Editing
editor.body: A save never overwrites a change made on disk after you opened the file: you see both and choose. Every save keeps the version it replaced (the last 20), and unsaved text survives closing the window.

copies.title: Copies in agent folders
copies.body: Saving a library skill refreshes its copies, except a copy that was changed in the agent's folder: that one is left alone and reported.

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: Before an update deletes a file you see which ones and approve. Automatic updates never delete files, and hold back skills you edited.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: A conflict never blocks a sync: your version stays until you choose, and a safety snapshot is taken first. Restoring a snapshot saves the current state first. Your GitHub token is encrypted with the system keychain.

library.title: Your data
library.body: Everything lives in ~/.loadout. Moving the library goes only into an empty folder and moves all or nothing. Removing all data takes {{app}}'s links out of agent folders first and never touches project folders.
